headline: Turkmenistan Transit Cargo Volume Increases 15% in Jan-Oct
summary: The volume of transit cargo transported through Turkmenistan increased by 15% year-on-year in January-October 2026, outpacing the 10% growth in total border freight.
why: Transit freight growth highlights Central Asia's expanding role as a cross-continental trade corridor between Europe and Asia.

impacts.name: Turkmenistan
impacts.why: Higher transit cargo volumes generate increased transport service revenues and border logistics activity.
